elder.d3e392f9: The Ember cracked in three. One shard sleeps under Whisperwood, east of here. Bring it home and the town will breathe again.
elder.148b3114: Three of three. The plinth burns like it did when I was a boy. Whatever comes now, Emberfall is warm.
elder.b525388c: Two flames. The last one sleeps under the mountain - that smoke on the south road is its breath. The Cinder road isn't cut yet; rest while it is.
elder.5d8569bd: You brought it back. One flame of three... the plinth will hold it. Rest, then look west: the marsh road has drained.
elder.84a7bad2: The wardens carved what they knew into the Hollow's signs. Read me three of them when you're back; my eyes are done with small letters.
elder.4c548785: So that's what they wrote. Old words, but they still hold. Take this for the walking.

apothecary.2a936498: Potions for coin, dear. Bombs too, if you promise not to use them indoors.
apothecary.a32e8f42: The Hollow's mushrooms - the big ones that puff spores. Bring me the caps of four and I'll make it worth the walk.
apothecary.817fa908: Four caps. These will steep for a month. Here - and take a potion for the trouble.

blacksmith.d1f982ed: Back from the Hollow with all your fingers. Good. Bring me gold and I'll put an edge on that sword you'd not believe.
blacksmith.4323fa5f: Those slag brutes under the mountain - their shells hold a metal I can't get anywhere else. Crack five and bring me what falls off.
blacksmith.84f56744: Look at that shine. I'll be at the forge all week. This is yours.
